name: syno-workspace-mcp
description: Connects Claude to Synology Drive and Synology Spreadsheet through your own syno-workspace-mcp server.
long_description: Bridge to a syno-workspace-mcp server running on your Synology NAS. Enter the server URL (for example https://nas.example.com:3443/mcp) and the access token (MCP_AUTH_TOKEN) set on the server. Tools that overwrite, rename or delete do nothing unless called with confirm: true.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Address of your syno-workspace-mcp server, for example https://nas.example.com:3443/mcp

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Value of MCP_AUTH_TOKEN on the server.
